current_text.html: Proposed decision(s) of any judicial panel shall be circulated to the entire Standing Judicial Commission. It shall act upon the recommended decision(s) without further hearings unless a party to the case, or a commission member, requests a rehearing of the case by the Standing Judicial Commission as a whole. The commission may or may not grant such a rehearing; except such rehearing must be granted when requested by a voting member of the panel or by at least seven qualified members of the commission. If granted, such rehearing shall be only on the record of the case; but the commission may allow oral arguments by the parties.
